regions.name: Roma residents · Romania
regions.basis: Separate geographic resident reconstruction. Dated institutional estimates, chiefly CoE2012 and later reproductions, are chosen as2012/2025 display references rather than asserted as2025 censuses. Country groups are disjoint; existing locally remaining child stocks are included once, and only the target deficit is added. Historical mobile groups do not classify every modern resident. Ukraine displacement and differing umbrella/census categories remain unresolved. No original source population, ancestry or historical chronology is overwritten.

regions.name: Sinti and Manuš historical residents
regions.basis: Separate geographic resident reconstruction. Dated institutional estimates, chiefly CoE2012 and later reproductions, are chosen as2012/2025 display references rather than asserted as2025 censuses. Country groups are disjoint; existing locally remaining child stocks are included once, and only the target deficit is added. Historical mobile groups do not classify every modern resident. Ukraine displacement and differing umbrella/census categories remain unresolved. No original source population, ancestry or historical chronology is overwritten. Selected50/70/100k historical Sinti/Manuš regional reference is anchored in the German about70k national-minority estimate, distinct from later foreign-origin MODERN-WEST migrants. France/Low Countries footprint shares are illustrative; German70k is not a French resident count. Bounds are chosen model alternatives, not the published70–150k range.

reconstructionBasis: 1938 minimum =25% of the modern regional reference plus only its already allocated1939–1945 losses;1946 minimum =25%,1988 minimum =70%,2012/2025 reference =100%. These multipliers are transparent backward/forward display calibrations, not measured censuses, fertility, victim distributions or demographic growth rates. Existing local stocks/internal transfers are counted once; only deficits are progressively supported after established lineage.
limitations: Separate geographic resident reconstruction. Dated institutional estimates, chiefly CoE2012 and later reproductions, are chosen as2012/2025 display references rather than asserted as2025 censuses. Country groups are disjoint; existing locally remaining child stocks are included once, and only the target deficit is added. Historical mobile groups do not classify every modern resident. Ukraine displacement and differing umbrella/census categories remain unresolved. No original source population, ancestry or historical chronology is overwritten.
Kosovo mixed-category estimate is retained as contextual alternative25/37.5/50k and excluded from these aggregate totals.
The model is still a selected regional reconstruction, not a census of all Roma worldwide. Spain, Britain, France and other resident totals are not silently inferred from migrant cohorts.
